service.description: Called before an account service runs (service/Demo.secas.xml): an error, which stops that service, when its user is a shared demo login (the property demo@shared-user-ids). One visitor would otherwise lock every other out by changing the password, adding a sign-in factor, or renaming or disabling the account. The user is found as update#Password and reset#Password find it: by userId, else by username (exactly, then as an email address), else the current user.

parameter.name: username
parameter.description: The user, or with accountUpdate the new username.

parameter.name: accountUpdate
parameter.description: From update#UserAccount: only the name, email address, locale, time zone and currency may change; any other field of the account given (changes) that differs from the row is refused, an allow-list (SEC-DEV-83: terminateDate or ipAllowed would lock every visitor out).

parameter.name: changes
parameter.description: With accountUpdate, the fields update#UserAccount was given.

return.message: The demo login cannot be changed on this demo server.

set.from: Array.from(ec.entity.getEntityDefinition('moqui.security.UserAccount').getAllFieldNames()) .map(String).filter(name => !mayChange.includes(name) && changes != null && changes[name] != null && String(changes[name]) != String(userAccount.get(name) ?? ''))

return.message: The demo login cannot be changed on this demo server.
